findings.must_convey: The application use case imports and constructs the concrete Octokit SDK, an outbound adapter dependency; define an application-owned port and inject its implementation at composition.
The application package imports Drizzle and exposes a database row type as its contract; application types should be independent of persistence representation.
The use case returns an infrastructure Drizzle row shape instead of an application-owned result type mapped at the repository boundary.
